vision._note: gopiv is a BENCH TEST RIG (one motor, no wheels, never on the playfield); no physical AprilTag is mounted. robot_tag_id inherited from the template for schema completeness only.

wheel_control._stall_note: 2026-08-09: added so this robot can be BUILT at all -- gen_boot_config.py requires all three (config-as-truth, sprint 114) and they were added to tovez.json only, which left gopiv and togov unbuildable. Held at 0, which is the documented INERT state, not a guess: tovez.json's own _stall_note says 'the whole detector is inert on any robot whose JSON leaves stall_window at 0'. gopiv has no drive characterization of its own, and tovez's numbers (15.0 / 40.0 / 500.0) are DESIGN CHOICES derived from tovez's own measured v_min, deadband and planner.a_max -- none of which have been measured here -- so borrowing them would be a fabricated calibration, not a default. Same posture togov.json takes for its uncharacterized wheel_control group. Replace with gopiv's own numbers before relying on stall detection on this robot. NOTE: togov.json still has this gap and is still unbuildable.

planner._timing_note: control_period/actuation_delay are '= App::RobotLoop::kCycle' by construction; both moved 50.0 -> 32.0 with kCycle on 2026-08-07. See data/robots/tovez.json's own planner._timing_note for the measurements and the full history.

navigator._navigator_note: 135-004: seeded from Motion::NavigatorLimits' own compile-time defaults (src/firm/motion/navigator/arc_solver.h) -- same pattern as tovez.json's own navigator block (see that file's note for the full rationale). yaw_sign=1.0 (identity, unmeasured) pending this robot's own bench pass -- tovez.json's -1.0 is a tovez-specific measured fact (src/tests/bench/goto_otos.py's own YAW_SIGN), not assumed to transfer to a different drivetrain without its own measurement.

encoders._note: the rig has ONE physical motor; the firmware's differential config still models two channels.

_provenance_note: 2026-08-05: reconstructed FROM THE RUNNING DEVICE via protocol v5 GetConfig read-back of all eight groups (rogo repl 'get <group>' against gopiv, firmware 0.20260804.6, every group BAKED) -- the gopiv.json that built 0.20260804.6 was not in this repo. All wire-group values are the device's own, float32 round-trip artifacts rounded back (0.7048599720001221 -> 0.70486 etc.). Non-wire sections (identity/vision/wheels/encoders/gripper/peripherals) are template-shaped from tovez.json and marked where they are placeholders. Radio channel: the firmware pins channel 0 in main.cpp (no config field, no wire verb); the 2026-08-05 bench flash carries a main.cpp literal radio.begin(1) NOT committed anywhere -- adding a proper radio-channel config field is the durable fix.
